attribution.text: Macros: Classic WoW Forever, licenciadas sob CC BY 4.0.

macros.title: Holy Strike and auto attack
macros.desc: Use Forever’s baseline strike without leaving auto attack off.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Holy Strike
/startattack
/cast Holy Strike
macros.needs: Holy Strike learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Golpe Sagrado
/startattack
/cast Golpe Sagrado

macros.title: Mouseover Blessing of Protection
macros.desc: Protect a friendly mouseover, your friendly target, or whoever your enemy target is attacking. Hold Alt for Divine Protection on yourself. Both apply Forbearance.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:alt] Divine Protection; Blessing of Protection
/cast [mod:alt] Divine Protection; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@targettarget,help,nodead] Blessing of Protection

keys.text: Blessing of Protection: mouseover, then friendly target, then target's target

macros.needs: Blessing of Protection learned; Divine Protection for Alt
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:alt] Proteção Divina; Bênção de Proteção
/cast [mod:alt] Proteção Divina; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@targettarget,help,nodead] Bênção de Proteção

macros.title: Blessings on one button
macros.desc: Blessing of Might on your mouseover or friendly target. Hold Shift for Wisdom or Ctrl for Kings.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift] Blessing of Wisdom; [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:ctrl] Blessing of Kings; [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Blessing of Might

keys.text: Blessing of Might on your mouseover, then your target

macros.needs: Blessing of Might, Wisdom and Kings learned. Blizzard confirms Kings is baseline, learned at level 20.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift] Bênção de Sabedoria; [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:ctrl] Bênção dos Reis; [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Bênção do Poder

macros.title: Auras on one button
macros.desc: Devotion Aura on a normal press. Hold Shift for Concentration Aura or Ctrl for Retribution Aura.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Concentration Aura; [mod:ctrl] Retribution Aura; Devotion Aura
/cast [mod:shift] Concentration Aura; [mod:ctrl] Retribution Aura; Devotion Aura
macros.needs: Devotion, Retribution and Concentration Aura learned (Concentration is level 22)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Aura de Concentração; [mod:ctrl] Aura da Retribuição; Aura de Devoção
/cast [mod:shift] Aura de Concentração; [mod:ctrl] Aura da Retribuição; Aura de Devoção

macros.title: Resistance auras on one button
macros.desc: Fire Resistance Aura on a normal press. Hold Shift for Frost or Ctrl for Shadow when a fight calls for it. In Forever they reach the whole raid within 30 yards.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Frost Resistance Aura; [mod:ctrl] Shadow Resistance Aura; Fire Resistance Aura
/cast [mod:shift] Frost Resistance Aura; [mod:ctrl] Shadow Resistance Aura; Fire Resistance Aura
macros.needs: All three resistance auras learned (Fire is level 36)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Aura de Resistência ao Gelo; [mod:ctrl] Aura de Resistência à Sombra; Aura de Resistência ao Fogo
/cast [mod:shift] Aura de Resistência ao Gelo; [mod:ctrl] Aura de Resistência à Sombra; Aura de Resistência ao Fogo

macros.title: Mouseover Lay on Hands
macros.desc: Lay on Hands on your mouseover, then your friendly target, then yourself. It heals for your max health and drains the rest of your mana.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Lay on Hands
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Lay on Hands
macros.needs: Lay on Hands learned (level 10); 20 minute cooldown
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Impor as Mãos
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Impor as Mãos

macros.title: Divine Shield, and drop it early
macros.desc: Press to bubble. Press again to drop it once you're safe. The same press also cancels Divine Protection and Blessing of Protection, which stop you attacking.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Divine Shield
/cancelaura Divine Shield
/cancelaura Divine Protection
/cancelaura Blessing of Protection
/cast Divine Shield
macros.needs: Divine Shield learned (level 34)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Escudo Divino
/cancelaura Escudo Divino
/cancelaura Proteção Divina
/cancelaura Bênção de Proteção
/cast Escudo Divino

macros.title: Mouseover Redemption
macros.desc: Resurrect the dead player under your cursor, or your dead target. It's a 10 second cast and you can't use it in combat.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Redemption
/cast [@mouseover,help,dead][help,dead] Redemption
macros.needs: Redemption learned (level 12)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Redenção
/cast [@mouseover,help,dead][help,dead] Redenção

macros.title: Exorcism or Turn Undead
macros.desc: Exorcism on an Undead or Demon target. Hold Shift for Turn Undead to send an Undead enemy running.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Turn Undead; Exorcism
/cast [mod:shift,harm,nodead] Turn Undead; [harm,nodead] Exorcism
macros.needs: Exorcism (level 20) and Turn Undead (level 24) learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Esconjurar Morto-vivo; Exorcismo
/cast [mod:shift,harm,nodead] Esconjurar Morto-vivo; [harm,nodead] Exorcismo

macros.title: Mouseover Holy Light
macros.desc: Heal a friendly mouseover first, then your target, then yourself.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Holy Light
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Holy Light
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Luz Sagrada
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Luz Sagrada

macros.title: Mouseover Flash of Light
macros.desc: Keep your enemy target while healing a party frame under your cursor.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Flash of Light
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Flash of Light
macros.needs: Flash of Light learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Clarão de Luz
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Clarão de Luz

macros.title: Holy Light ranks on Shift and Ctrl
macros.desc: Heal your mouseover or friendly target with your top rank, or a cheaper one with Shift (rank 7) or Ctrl (rank 5).
macros.code:
#showtooltip Holy Light
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift] Holy Light(Rank 7); [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:ctrl] Holy Light(Rank 5); [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Holy Light

keys.text: Your top rank of Holy Light

macros.needs: Holy Light ranks 5 and 7 learned (level 46); change the ranks to ones you have
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Luz Sagrada
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift] Luz Sagrada(Grau 7); [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:ctrl] Luz Sagrada(Grau 5); [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Luz Sagrada

macros.title: Flash of Light ranks on Shift and Ctrl
macros.desc: Top up your mouseover or friendly target with your top rank, or a cheaper one with Shift (rank 5) or Ctrl (rank 3).
macros.code:
#showtooltip Flash of Light
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift] Flash of Light(Rank 5); [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:ctrl] Flash of Light(Rank 3); [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Flash of Light

keys.text: Your top rank of Flash of Light

macros.needs: Flash of Light ranks 3 and 5 learned (level 50); change the ranks to ones you have
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Clarão de Luz
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift] Clarão de Luz(Grau 5); [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:ctrl] Clarão de Luz(Grau 3); [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Clarão de Luz

macros.title: Heal whoever the enemy is fighting
macros.desc: With an enemy targeted, Flash of Light goes to your mouseover, then your friendly target, then whoever that enemy is attacking. Hold Shift for Holy Light.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Holy Light; Flash of Light
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@targettarget,help,nodead] Holy Light; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@targettarget,help,nodead] Flash of Light

keys.text: Flash of Light on mouseover, friendly target, or your enemy's target
Holy Light on the same targets

macros.needs: Flash of Light learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Luz Sagrada; Clarão de Luz
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@targettarget,help,nodead] Luz Sagrada; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@targettarget,help,nodead] Clarão de Luz

macros.title: Holy Shock on a friend or an enemy
macros.desc: Holy Shock your mouseover, then your target, then yourself. It heals an ally and damages an enemy. Hold Alt to shock yourself.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Holy Shock
/cast [mod:alt,@player][@mouseover,exists,nodead][exists,nodead][@player] Holy Shock

keys.text: Holy Shock on mouseover, then target, then yourself

macros.needs: Holy Shock talent (it starts at level 30 in Forever)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Choque Sagrado
/cast [mod:alt,@player][@mouseover,exists,nodead][exists,nodead][@player] Choque Sagrado

macros.title: Light's Vigil, then Holy Shock
macros.desc: Mark your friendly mouseover or target with Light's Vigil, then hold Shift and press to Holy Shock the same target for the bonus effect.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Holy Shock; Light's Vigil
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,exists,nodead][mod:shift,exists,nodead] Holy Shock; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Light's Vigil

keys.text: Light's Vigil on a friendly mouseover, friendly target or yourself
Holy Shock on your mouseover or target

macros.needs: Light's Vigil and Holy Shock talents; the mark lasts 30 seconds, and since 2 November it only goes on friends
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Choque Sagrado; Luz Zelosa
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,exists,nodead][mod:shift,exists,nodead] Choque Sagrado; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Luz Zelosa

macros.title: Divine Favor into a heal
macros.desc: Pop Divine Favor and heal in one press so the heal is a sure critical. Holy Light by default, Flash of Light with Shift.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Flash of Light; Holy Light
/cast Divine Favor
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift] Flash of Light; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Holy Light

keys.text: Divine Favor, then Flash of Light

macros.needs: Divine Favor talent; 2 minute cooldown
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Clarão de Luz; Luz Sagrada
/cast Favorecimento Divino
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift] Clarão de Luz; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Luz Sagrada

macros.title: Mouseover Purify
macros.desc: Remove a disease and a poison from your mouseover, then your friendly target, then yourself.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Purify
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Purify
macros.needs: Purify learned (level 8)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Purificar
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Purificar

macros.title: Mouseover Cleanse
macros.desc: Cleanse a poison, a disease and a magic effect from your mouseover, then your friendly target, then yourself. Hold Alt to cleanse yourself.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Cleanse
/cast [mod:alt,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Cleanse

keys.text: Cleanse on mouseover, then friendly target, then yourself

macros.needs: Cleanse learned (level 42)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Purificação
/cast [mod:alt,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Purificação

macros.title: Seal of Wisdom, Seal of Light or Judgement
macros.desc: Hold Shift for Seal of Wisdom or Ctrl for Seal of Light, then press normally to judge. Judgement no longer uses the Seal up, so you don't recast it.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Seal of Wisdom; [mod:ctrl] Seal of Light; Judgement
/cast [mod:shift] Seal of Wisdom; [mod:ctrl] Seal of Light; Judgement
macros.needs: Seal of Wisdom (level 38) or Seal of Light (level 30); Seal and Judgement are separate presses
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Selo da Sabedoria; [mod:ctrl] Selo da Luz; Julgamento
/cast [mod:shift] Selo da Sabedoria; [mod:ctrl] Selo da Luz; Julgamento

macros.title: Seal of Fury or Judgement
macros.desc: Hold Shift to apply Seal of Fury. A normal press judges, and with the Seal up that Judgement taunts your target for 3 seconds.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Seal of Fury; Judgement
/cast [mod:shift] Seal of Fury; Judgement
macros.needs: Seal of Fury learned (level 10); Seal and Judgement are separate presses
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Selo da Fúria; Julgamento
/cast [mod:shift] Selo da Fúria; Julgamento

macros.title: Consecration and Righteous Fury
macros.desc: Hold Shift to turn on Righteous Fury before a pull. Press normally for Consecration.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Righteous Fury; Consecration
/cast [mod:shift] Righteous Fury; Consecration
macros.needs: Consecration and Righteous Fury learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Fúria Íntegra; Consagração
/cast [mod:shift] Fúria Íntegra; Consagração

macros.title: Holy Shield and Judgement
macros.desc: One press judges (Judgement is off the global cooldown) and raises Holy Shield.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Holy Shield
/startattack
/cast Judgement
/cast Holy Shield
macros.needs: Holy Shield talent; a shield equipped; a Seal up
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Escudo Sagrado
/startattack
/cast Julgamento
/cast Escudo Sagrado

macros.title: Hammer of the Righteous or Holy Strike
macros.desc: Hammer of the Righteous hits your target and up to 3 nearby enemies on a 6 second cooldown. Hold Shift for Holy Strike.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Holy Strike; Hammer of the Righteous
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Holy Strike; Hammer of the Righteous
macros.needs: Hammer of the Righteous (level 40) and Holy Strike learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Golpe Sagrado; Martelo do Íntegro
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Golpe Sagrado; Martelo do Íntegro

macros.title: Judgement or Swift Judgement
macros.desc: Press to judge. Hold Shift for Swift Judgement, which unleashes your Seal again on its own 1 minute cooldown, separate from Judgement’s.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Swift Judgement; Judgement
/cast [mod:shift] Swift Judgement; Judgement
macros.needs: Swift Judgement talent, which now needs Templar's Bulwark; a Seal up
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Julgamento Célere; Julgamento
/cast [mod:shift] Julgamento Célere; Julgamento

macros.title: Templar's Bulwark or Divine Protection
macros.desc: Templar's Bulwark puts an absorb equal to your max health on you for 8 seconds. Hold Shift for Divine Protection instead. Both apply Forbearance.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Divine Protection; Templar's Bulwark
/cast [mod:shift] Divine Protection; Templar's Bulwark
macros.needs: Templar's Bulwark talent; neither works while Forbearance is up
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Proteção Divina; Baluarte do Templário
/cast [mod:shift] Proteção Divina; Baluarte do Templário

macros.title: Righteous Fury on, Shift to drop it
macros.desc: Press to turn on Righteous Fury before a pull. Hold Shift to cancel it when you switch to damage or healing.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Righteous Fury
/cast [nomod:shift] Righteous Fury
/stopmacro [nomod:shift]
/cancelaura Righteous Fury
macros.needs: Righteous Fury learned (level 10)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fúria Íntegra
/cast [nomod:shift] Fúria Íntegra
/stopmacro [nomod:shift]
/cancelaura Fúria Íntegra

macros.title: Judge the mob under your cursor
macros.desc: Judge your mouseover enemy, or your target if you aren't pointing at one. With Seal of Fury up, that Judgement taunts for 3 seconds.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Judgement
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Judgement
macros.needs: Seal of Fury up; Judgement reaches 10 yards
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Julgamento
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Julgamento

macros.title: Blessing of Sacrifice on a party member
macros.desc: Put Blessing of Sacrifice on your mouseover or friendly target so part of each hit lands on you. It only works on party members.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Blessing of Sacrifice
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead] Blessing of Sacrifice
macros.needs: Blessing of Sacrifice learned (level 46)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Bênção do Sacrifício
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead] Bênção do Sacrifício

macros.title: Seal of Fury, Righteousness or Justice
macros.desc: Seal of Fury by default. Shift picks Seal of Righteousness, and Ctrl picks Seal of Justice, whose Judgement stops the enemy fleeing.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Seal of Righteousness; [mod:ctrl] Seal of Justice; Seal of Fury
/cast [mod:shift] Seal of Righteousness; [mod:ctrl] Seal of Justice; Seal of Fury
macros.needs: Seal of Fury (level 10) and Seal of Justice (level 22) learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Selo da Retidão; [mod:ctrl] Selo da Justiça; Selo da Fúria
/cast [mod:shift] Selo da Retidão; [mod:ctrl] Selo da Justiça; Selo da Fúria

macros.title: Seal of Command or Judgement
macros.desc: Hold Shift to apply Seal of Command, then press normally to judge. Judgement no longer uses the Seal up, so one Seal covers many Judgements.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Seal of Command; Judgement
/cast [mod:shift] Seal of Command; Judgement
macros.needs: Seal of Command talent; Seal and Judgement are separate presses
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Selo de Comando; Julgamento
/cast [mod:shift] Selo de Comando; Julgamento

macros.title: Hammer of Wrath or Holy Strike
macros.desc: Hold Shift for the ranged finisher on a target at 20% health or less. A normal press uses Holy Strike.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Hammer of Wrath; Holy Strike
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Hammer of Wrath; Holy Strike
macros.needs: Hammer of Wrath learned (level 44); Holy Strike learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Martelo da Ira; Golpe Sagrado
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Martelo da Ira; Golpe Sagrado

macros.title: Judgement and Holy Strike
macros.desc: Judgement is off the global cooldown, so one press judges and Holy Strikes. With Sacred Arbiter, Holy Strike also refreshes every Judgement on the target, other Paladins’ included.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Holy Strike
/startattack
/cast Judgement
/cast Holy Strike
macros.needs: A Seal up; Sacred Arbiter talent for the refresh
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Golpe Sagrado
/startattack
/cast Julgamento
/cast Golpe Sagrado

macros.title: Swap Seals for Unsealed Wrath
macros.desc: Each press swaps between Seal of Command and Seal of Righteousness. Unsealed Wrath stores up to 3 copies of your Seal from your swings, and the first hit after a swap gives each copy its chance to go off.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=combat Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness
/startattack
macros.needs: Seal of Command and Unsealed Wrath talents (level 40); each swap costs a global cooldown
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=combat Selo de Comando, Selo da Retidão
/startattack

macros.title: Opener: Crusader, Judgement, Command
macros.desc: Three presses: Seal of the Crusader, Judgement, then Seal of Command. It starts over 10 seconds after your last press.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=10 Seal of the Crusader, Judgement, Seal of Command
/startattack
macros.needs: Seal of Command talent; if Judgement is on cooldown the sequence waits at that step
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=10 Selo do Cruzado, Julgamento, Selo de Comando
/startattack

macros.title: Judgement, or Consecration on Shift
macros.desc: Judge on a normal press with auto attack on. Hold Shift for Consecration when enemies are standing around you.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Consecration; Judgement
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Consecration; Judgement
macros.needs: Consecration learned (level 20); a Seal up
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Consagração; Julgamento
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Consagração; Julgamento

macros.title: Judgement, with trinkets on Shift
macros.desc: Judge on a normal press. Hold Shift to use both trinkets first, with Judgement right after.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Judgement
/use [mod:shift] 13
/use [mod:shift] 14
/cast Judgement
macros.needs: On-use trinkets in both trinket slots
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Julgamento
/use [mod:shift] 13
/use [mod:shift] 14
/cast Julgamento

macros.title: Seal of Righteousness, Command or the Crusader
macros.desc: Seal of Righteousness by default. Shift picks Seal of Command, and Ctrl picks Seal of the Crusader.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Seal of Command; [mod:ctrl] Seal of the Crusader; Seal of Righteousness
/cast [mod:shift] Seal of Command; [mod:ctrl] Seal of the Crusader; Seal of Righteousness
macros.needs: Seal of the Crusader (level 6); Seal of Command needs its talent
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Selo de Comando; [mod:ctrl] Selo do Cruzado; Selo da Retidão
/cast [mod:shift] Selo de Comando; [mod:ctrl] Selo do Cruzado; Selo da Retidão

macros.title: Exorcism with Judgement
macros.desc: Request Exorcism and Judgement on your target. Exorcism still needs an Undead or Demon; Judgement needs an active seal and a target in range.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Exorcism
/cast [harm,nodead] Exorcism
/cast [harm,nodead] Judgement
macros.needs: Exorcism and Judgement learned; a seal active for Judgement
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Exorcismo
/cast [harm,nodead] Exorcismo
/cast [harm,nodead] Julgamento

macros.title: Hammer of Justice on target or mouseover
macros.desc: Drops your cast and your mount, then stuns your target. Hold Shift to stun the enemy under your cursor instead.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Hammer of Justice
/dismount
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Hammer of Justice
macros.needs: Hammer of Justice learned (level 8); it cancels a cast even if the stun is on cooldown
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Martelo da Justiça
/dismount
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Martelo da Justiça

macros.title: Blessing of Freedom on a friend or yourself
macros.desc: Free your mouseover, then your friendly target, then yourself. Hold Alt to free yourself. It gives 10 seconds of immunity to movement impairing effects.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Blessing of Freedom
/cast [mod:alt,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Blessing of Freedom

keys.text: Freedom on mouseover, then friendly target, then yourself

macros.needs: Blessing of Freedom learned (level 18)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Bênção da Liberdade
/cast [mod:alt,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Bênção da Liberdade

macros.title: Lay on Hands: you, or a friend with Shift or Ctrl
macros.desc: Cancels your cast (even if Lay on Hands is on cooldown), then lays hands on you. Shift picks your friendly mouseover and Ctrl your friendly target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Lay on Hands
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:ctrl,help,nodead][@player] Lay on Hands

keys.text: Lay on Hands on your friendly mouseover
Lay on Hands on your friendly target

macros.needs: Lay on Hands learned (level 10)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Impor as Mãos
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:ctrl,help,nodead][@player] Impor as Mãos

macros.title: Hammer of Wrath on target or mouseover
macros.desc: Finish an enemy at 20% health or less from range. Hold Shift to pick the one under your cursor.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Hammer of Wrath
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Hammer of Wrath

keys.text: Hammer of Wrath on your target
Hammer of Wrath on your mouseover

macros.needs: Hammer of Wrath learned (level 44); the target must be at 20% health or less
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Martelo da Ira
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Martelo da Ira

macros.title: Racial escape for Human, Dwarf or Undead
macros.desc: One button for whichever racial you have. Will to Survive removes stuns, Stoneform removes bleeds, poisons and diseases, and Will of the Forsaken removes charm, fear and sleep.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast Will to Survive
/cast Stoneform
/cast Will of the Forsaken
macros.needs: Human, Dwarf or Undead; the lines for the other races do nothing
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast Desejo de Sobreviver
/cast Forma de Pedra
/cast Determinação dos Renegados

macros.title: Target the nearest enemy and attack
macros.desc: Picks the nearest enemy if you don't have a live enemy target, then starts auto attack. Shift always jumps to the nearest enemy, and Alt goes back to your last enemy target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Attack
/targetlastenemy [mod:alt]
/targetenemy [mod:shift][noharm][dead]
/startattack [harm,nodead]
